eval.sample: Once upon a time, there was a little bird. The bird liked to fly high in the sky and sing beautiful songs. One day, the bird saw a big cloud in the sky. It had a big shadow on its back. The bird wanted to see the cloud. So, the bird flew up to the cloud and sang a song. The cloud was so pretty that it sang a song. The cloud was so happy that it sang a song about the wide cloud.
